segments.intent: Count distinct companies whose postings mention R and data visualization
segments.value:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT company) AS company_count
FROM scout_postings
WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(description, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%r%'
  AND (LOWER(COALESCE(description, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%data visualization%'
       OR LOWER(COALESCE(description, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%data visualisation%')
```
